zin_shared_cold_lands_lean_neighbours = {
	every_neighbor_country = {
		limit = { zin_cold_is_clan_realm = yes }
		zin_cold_add_lean = yes
	}
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_value (number).
zin_shared_cold_lands_lean_toward_zero = {
	# Moves the lean toward 0 by zin_arg_value, never past 0. zin_cold_add_lean reads zin_arg_value.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_cold_lean > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_cl_step = zin_arg_value }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_cl_step > zin_cold_lean } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_cl_step = zin_cold_lean }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_cl_step = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_cl_step }
		zin_cold_add_lean = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_cold_lean < 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_cl_step = zin_arg_value }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_cl_room = zin_cold_lean }
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_cl_room = -1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_cl_step > zin_cl_room } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_cl_step = zin_cl_room }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_cl_step }
		zin_cold_add_lean = yes
	}
}

zin_shared_cold_lands_offer_coast_league = {
	# Picks the Light partner with the most owned states and fires zin_shared_cold_lands.5 to it.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_cl_best = 0 }
	every_other_country = {
		limit = { zin_shared_cold_lands_light_partner_of_root = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_cl_n = num_owned_states }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_cl_n > zin_cl_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_cl_best = zin_cl_n }
		}
	}
	random_other_country = {
		limit = {
			zin_shared_cold_lands_light_partner_of_root = yes
			check_variable = { num_owned_states = zin_cl_best }
		}
		country_event = { id = zin_shared_cold_lands.5 }
	}
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_who (country), zin_arg_modifier (1-based position in the opinion_modifiers block), zin_arg_both (1 for both ways).
zin_shared_cold_lands_opinion = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 1 }
		}
		var:zin_arg_who = {
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = PREV
				modifier = zin_shared_cold_lands_town_league
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
				}
				add_opinion_modifier = {
					target = PREV
					modifier = zin_shared_cold_lands_town_league
				}
			}
		}
	}
